 Juice of bhang – Marijuana (Cannabis sativa)

 Juice of fresh plant of bhang should be used. If fresh plant is not available take the leaf part of bhang to be boiled with water to make decoction in sufficient quantity for carrying out mardana (trituration) for one day.

 Medicinal action of this medicine is quite good to manage the various problems like fever, diarrhea, indigestion etc. This medicine helps to improve the digestive fire in the body. Use of this medicine is quite effective to decrease the body heat in fever. Moreover it helps to manage the symptoms associated with IBS like diarrhea abdominal pain or cramping, or constipation, diarrhea bloated feeling, gas, mucus in stools etc. In the diarrhea, this medicine helps to extrude the bacteria from intestine which are responsible for infection. It helps to manage the problems with diarrhea like loose, watery stools, abdominal cramps, abdominal pain, fever, blood in the stool, bloating, nausea etc.

Maha Kanaka Sundara Rasa – Benefits, Usage, Indications and Dosage 
 Reference: The Ayurvedic formulary of India- part 2, 1st edition, page no. 230. 
 Maha Kanaka Sundara Rasa is used in the treatment of fever, diarrhea and stomach problems. Use of this medicine is good to improve the digestive fire. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Hingula (Purified cinnabar) 
 Marica (Piper nigrum) 
 Gandhak (Purified sulphur) 
 Pippali (Piper longum) 
 Tankana (Purified Borax) 
 Vatsanabha (Purified Aconitum ferox) 
 Kanka bija (Purified Dhattura metel) 
 Juice of bhang – Marijuana (Cannabis sativa) 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 Juice of fresh plant of bhang should be used. If fresh plant is not available take the leaf part of bhang to be boiled with water to make decoction in sufficient quantity for carrying out mardana (trituration) for one day. 
 Medicinal Properties 
 Medicinal action of this medicine is quite good to manage the various problems like fever, diarrhea, indigestion etc. This medicine helps to improve the digestive fire in the body. Use of this medicine is quite effective to decrease the body heat in fever. This medicine acts well to manage the digestive health issues like indigestion, nausea, vomiting, flatulence etc. For Irritable Bowel Syndrome (IBS), it helps to increase the digestive fire and remove the accumulated toxins (ama) from body. Moreover it helps to manage the symptoms associated with IBS like diarrhea abdominal pain or cramping, or constipation, diarrhea bloated feeling, gas, mucus in stools etc. In the diarrhea, this medicine helps to extrude the bacteria from intestine which are responsible for infection. It helps to manage the problems with diarrhea like loose, watery stools, abdominal cramps, abdominal pain, fever, blood in the stool, bloating, nausea etc. 
 Indications 
 
 IBS 
 Fever 
 Diarrhea 
 Low digestive fire 
 
 Dosage 
 125 mg 
 Side Effects 
 Take this medicine only under medical supervision. 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
